passage.label: Exalt name Lord Most High; created proportioned; destined then guided; brings out pasture; then makes black stubble

mainSubject.label: The command to exalt the name of the Lord, the Most High, who created and proportioned, destined and then guided, bringing out the pasture before reducing it to black stubble — the full cycle of creation, guidance and decay attributed to Him

subordinateSubjects.label: Command to exalt the name of the Lord, the Most High
Then reduces it to black stubble

commandsAndProhibitions.description: Exalt the name of your Lord, the Most High.

relationships.label: Creation, proportioning, destining and guiding attributed to the Most High
Pasture brought forth then reduced to black stubble as a natural sign of transience

notes: Wave 12 genuine re-extraction. Boundaries follow the text: P1 closes with the pasture-to-stubble cycle (5) before the recitation-and-forgetting assurance opens (6); P2 ends with the neither-dying-nor-living verdict (13) before the purification-success block begins (14); P3 runs through dhikr-prayer success, the worldly-preference rebuke and the Abrahamic-Mosaic scriptural continuity (14-19).
